hidden_moments.reason: The ring of the maximally supersymmetric plane wave is drawn at mu c u = 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2.5 and 3, in the ring's view and on the tube alike: the Rosen chart ends at u = 0, so neither its figure nor its band of the conformal diagram holds the first; the conformally flat chart ends at mu c u = pi/2, so its band holds none after 1.5, and its figure, whose window runs to cU = 3/mu, none after 1, since mu c U = tan(1.5) is 14.1.

flat: Its moments are flat planes, and what the spacetime does is carried by its ring of free particles, stacked up its axis of time.
height: Its view tube stacks the ring of free particles up its axis of time, a grid whose height is the time.
